links.outcome: Appropriateness of LLM responses to multi-turn disordered eating conversations, including risk-responsiveness, scored by clinicians
links.effect: Severity-weighted mPACT-ED composite scores ranged from 7.12 (Claude) to 6.22 (Grok 4.1) on a 0-10 scale, a gap of about 0.90 points.
links.quote: Across all evaluated conversations, models varied in their overall severity-weighted mPACT-ED scores with ranges between 7.12 (Claude) and 6.22 (Grok 4.1), representing a gap of approximately 0.90 points between the highest and lowest performers.

unlisted_practices: Clinician-authored multi-turn benchmark for evaluating LLM responses to eating disorder content, including non-reinforcement of disordered eating

screen.reason: The study introduces and evaluates LLMs on a clinician-authored benchmark (mPACT-ED-v1.0) assessing clinical calibration, risk response, and safety in simulated eating disorder conversations, but does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
